title: How to create simple interactive game using AI?
author: mohamed2m2018
selftext:
Hi, I am a mobile developer, and I have an idea for an interactive science game, but I have no game development experience. I don't want it to look like an AI-generated game, so I want advice from someone on where to start.

I tried to make something using Opus 5.5, but it turned out to be too basic, like this:  


[https://science-stories-episode-1.vercel.app/](https://science-stories-episode-1.vercel.app/)

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: you need to read this sub, look at all the games, the good ones and the bad ones. people can tell you but finding the common things on your own is easier.

comments.author: ZymzAlchemy
comments.body: Simple is better, especially in the beginning. It's best to spend some time mapping our what you want and how you think the end product should look, then draft some documents and concept images that will guide the agent as it creates. Agents work better when they don't have to do the creative thinking, this is the hard part.

comments.author: GilbyScarChest
comments.body:
Rule 1 of creating in AI: don’t create the whole game at once. Instead create each asset, each level, each system individually, then once they are all looking exactly how you want them, integrate them all together. 

Rule 2: Change every detail that the AI builds by default. Change the font, the color palette, the animations, the characters, the names, the dialogue, nothing should survive from iteration 1 to make it into your published game.

Rule 3: Don’t let AI create the whole project. Anything you can do on your own, do it. If you can draw, add artwork. If you can make music, add music. If you can code, write some of the mechanics yourself. If you can write, write the dialogue.

All of these rules will help you make something quality and unique that is not AI slop.

comments.author: e-scape
comments.body:
1. Make a project  
2. Gather context  
\- Discuss your ideas with the model.  
\- Let the model research relevant info to your ideas  
3. Prompt
